name: proto-upstream-copies-in-two-trees
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the include root of an upstream copy holds that copy alone: two directory trees that each keep a copy of one upstream schema and a schema file at one path below it, as a monorepo builds one service at a time, publish both files under their paths from the target root, each package decided by its bindings with no note on either file; the second tree's copy is shadowed by the first, which every import of the upstream path reads. Since a schema file not read cleanly, a shadowed one included, may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
